issues.title: Sometimes client doesn't register for changes
issues.body:
We have an intermittent problem.

Sometimes a browser client connects to Serge backend, but it doesn't register for changes.

The symptom of this behaviour is that the user can send messages, but doesn't see them, nor do they see new messages that are sent by others.

The health-check appears to work fine.

I believe this issue could be associated with this bug-fix:
https://github.com/serge-web/serge/pull/897

As previously reported here: https://github.com/serge-web/serge/issues/874#issuecomment-885556503

It's a real pain that this is intermittent.  I think I've just encountered it in this scenario:
* running yarn develop
* client connected to localhost
* kill yarn develop
* start yarn develop
* client not listening to changes
The above is ok, since the client registered with the server that had closed - so long polling would no longer work.

But, I'm also encountering it occasionally with new client connections.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/3ad819ce0cb6dedb78b02bc544baec22.gif)

Hmm, is it possible for the client to regularly check it is still listening for changes. _Maybe_ do it in the heartbeat?  It's a bit drastic, but I guess we could close the polling for `changes` and re-register.
